settings.title: Settings
settings.spindleEffect: Startup preset only. Does not start the spindle.
settings.spindleHint: Zero leaves the speed unset; never starts the spindle.
settings.jogEffect: Jog speed per minute at startup.
settings.formulasHint: Formulas work here too: {half} or {inch} per minute.
settings.wcsHint: Five shortcuts on the main row. Others appear under More.
settings.wcsAnyHint: Programs can use any system; the active one stays visible.
settings.referenceEffect: Contact height above work Z zero for tool length touch-off.
settings.referenceHint: Gauge block or setter contact height above work Z zero. Prefills Touch off length; does not move the machine.
settings.safeZEffect: Machine Z that Go to lifts to before X and Y move.
settings.usePresentZTip: Set safe Z to the present machine Z
settings.safeZHint: Machine coordinates. Go to lifts Z here, or stays higher, before X and Y move. Empty: {value}, the top of travel less {margin} mm.
settings.shiftText: G92/G52 adds an offset to every work system. CoffeeCNC shows it whenever applied. Work system shortcuts do not hide or clear it.
settings.invalidReference: Enter a tool reference height of zero or higher.
settings.invalidSafeZ: Enter a safe Z for Go to, or leave it empty.
settings.invalidWcs: Keep at least one work system shortcut.
settings.invalidSpindle: Enter a spindle speed of zero or higher.
settings.invalidJog: Enter a jog speed above zero.

settingsState.draftUnconfirmed: The machine connection changed. This draft was not confirmed saved.
settingsState.cannotSave: This backend cannot save settings. Changes last until CoffeeCNC closes.
settingsState.invalidIdentity: The machine did not provide a valid settings identity.
settingsState.noConfirmation: No save confirmation. The write may still finish; wait for refreshed settings before retrying.
settingsState.noUpdatedSettings: The save result arrived without updated settings. Reload CoffeeCNC to verify the saved values.
settingsState.connectionChanged: The connection changed. Close Settings and reopen it.
settingsState.savedChanged: Saved settings changed. Close Settings and reopen it.
settingsState.checkValues: Check the units, work systems and speeds.
settingsState.checkPositions: Check the saved position names and coordinates.
settingsState.speedLimit: A default speed exceeds the configured machine limit.
settingsState.sendFailed: The settings save could not be sent.
settingsState.browserStorage: Browser storage is unavailable. Settings were not saved.

statusBar.liftedAfterStop: Z is still lifted {lift}. Switch machine power off and on to clear the offset at this height.
statusBar.subtitle: {file} · Program in {units}
statusBar.dismissTip: Dismiss this message; keep it in the message log

machineBlock.connecting: No status from the machine yet
machineBlock.stale: LinuxCNC has stopped updating its status
machineBlock.incompatible: Panel and backend protocol versions do not match
machineBlock.pausedZRecovery: Z is still lifted. Turn machine power off and on to clear the offset here.

runBar.stopAndLift: Stop the spindle and lift Z
runBar.breakpointCheck: A breakpoint needs a complete program check
runBar.dismissSpindleConfirm: Dismiss the spindle confirmation before continuing
runBar.recoverSpindle: Press Stop to recover the interrupted spindle hold
runBar.restoreSpindle: Use Resume to restore the program spindle
runBar.returnZFirst: Use Resume to return Z before continuing
runBar.continueBreakpoint: Use Resume to continue the breakpoint run
runBar.stopTip: Stop program, MDI, jog and spindle
runBar.spindleConfirmTitle: Stop the spindle to lift Z?
runBar.spindleConfirmEffect: Z will lift {length} once the spindle stops. Resume returns Z, restarts the spindle, and waits for it to reach speed.

log.title: Message log
log.faultSilentTip: A frozen executable: no status and no answers.
log.faultStaleTip: LinuxCNC stopped writing its status; the last one keeps arriving.
log.faultDownTip: No connection to LinuxCNC; placeholder status.

quit.title: Quit CoffeeCNC?
quit.connectionChanged: The connection changed. Close this dialog and try again.
quit.unsupported: This backend does not support quitting from the panel.
quit.waitingLive: Waiting for a live machine connection.
quit.notConfirmed: Quit was not confirmed. CoffeeCNC may still be running.
quit.effect: LinuxCNC shuts down; the machine is switched off.
quit.simulatorNote: Browser simulator: the simulated machine switches off. This browser stays open.
quit.simulatedDone: Simulated quit completed. This browser stays open.
quit.accepted: Quit request accepted. Waiting for CoffeeCNC to close…
quit.waiting: Waiting for the quit request to be confirmed…

number.fieldChanged: The field changed or is no longer available. Cancel and reopen it.
number.effect: Updates this field only. Apply or run its action separately.
